question: What maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about September 30, 2020?
notes: Original 7.06(a): 3.75:1 every quarter. Amendment No. 1 (effective 2020-05-06) tests it only for the quarter ending on or about 2020-03-31 and from the quarter ending on or about 2021-06-30, so 2020-09-30 is not tested. Amendment No. 3's restated 7.06(a) starts at 2021-03-31 and does not reach back to this quarter.

question: What minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about June 30, 2020?
notes: Original 7.06(b): 3.00:1. Amendment No. 1's table sets 2.00:1 for the quarters ending on or about 2020-06-30 through 2021-03-31 (amendment-1 lines 1364-1366). Amendment No. 3 restates 7.06(b) only from the quarter ending on or about 2020-12-31, so it does not reach back. Tests the precedence rule. The qualified form (minimum/maximum) is also accepted: the question already names it (added after eval 2026-10-12T20-41-42Z-claude-opus-5-5-e15294 failed a correct 'minimum 3.00 to 1.00').

question: What minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about December 31, 2020?
notes: Amendment No. 1's table says 2.00:1, but Amendment No. 3 (dated 2021-02-09) restates 7.06(b) expressly for quarters ending on or after the one ending on or about 2020-12-31, at 3.00 to 1.00 (amendment-3 lines 23-24). Pairs with icr-q2-2020: the expressly-covered quarter. The qualified form (minimum/maximum) is also accepted: the question already names it (added after eval 2026-10-12T20-41-42Z-claude-opus-5-5-e15294 failed a correct 'minimum 3.00 to 1.00').

question: What minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about June 30, 2021?
notes: Amendment No. 3's restated 7.06(b) governs from the quarter ending on or about 2020-12-31: 3.00 to 1.00. Amendment No. 1's table also gives 3.00:1 from 2021-06-30, so an agent citing only amendment-1 has the right value but the superseded provision. The qualified form (minimum/maximum) is also accepted: the question already names it (added after eval 2026-10-12T20-41-42Z-claude-opus-5-5-e15294 failed a correct 'minimum 3.00 to 1.00').

question: Under Section 7.03(l), when incurring other Indebtedness that exceeds the clause's baskets, is the required pro forma Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio a minimum or a maximum, and at what ratio?
notes: Amendment No. 1's 7.03(l) says 'no greater than 2.00:1' (amendment-1 line 1352). Amendment No. 2 (dated 2020-05-19) corrects that defect and restates 7.03(l) as 'no less than 2.00:1' (amendment-2 lines 7, 11-14). An agent that stops at Amendment No. 1 gets the direction backwards.

question: Ignoring any increase permitted in connection with an acquisition, what maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about September 30, 2021?
notes: Amendment No. 3's restated 7.06(a) tests quarters from the one ending on or about 2021-03-31 (or 2021-06-30) at 3.75 to 1.00 (amendment-3 lines 21-22). From the 2021-09-30 quarter it also allows a step-up after a large acquisition, which the question excludes. The qualified form (minimum/maximum) is also accepted: the question already names it (added after eval 2026-10-12T20-41-42Z-claude-opus-5-5-e15294 failed a correct 'minimum 3.00 to 1.00').

question: What is the Letter of Credit Sublimit?
notes: Same wording in the original (line 513) and Amendment No. 1's restatement (line 733); Amendments No. 2 and 3 don't touch it. Amendment No. 1's restated definition is the version in force.
